notes: Drive AoE3 DE from the Main Menu to the Skirmish lobby.
Pre-condition: game launched, main menu visible (left vertical text menu
OCR-driven (no template captures). threshold:140 cleans up the dark-on-
wood Trajan caps; partial:true tolerates per-frame OCR noise. NO 'region'
field — locate_text_with_capture does NOT add the region offset back to
OCR coords (locate_image_with_capture does, OCR doesn't), so a region
would make every click_text land off-target by (region_left, region_top).
Full-frame OCR is plenty fast for menu navigation (~1s/attempt).
If a transient popup is on top of the menu (mod-loaded toast, sign-in
prompt), the optional Esc clears it before the click.
